expectations.text: Opening uses a provocative question or bold claim; doesn't bury the lede
expectations.evidence: Strong pattern-based lede ('The first warning sign is usually not latency... It is a calendar.') — engaging and not buried, though achieved without explicit skill guidance.

expectations.text: Major claims backed by numbers/examples from notes; unbackable claims [FILL] or cut
expectations.evidence: All note numbers used (dozen, 5 years, ~2, 8/15, 40%, 20+); [FILL] markers for measurement method and anonymized examples.

expectations.text: Ending includes a concrete next action
expectations.evidence: Question checklist before splitting + 'Start there.' — actionable, though less specific than a this-week action.

expectations.text: Closes with genuine engagement question, no like-begging
expectations.evidence: No engagement question anywhere; post ends on the tribute-band quip. Old skill has no CTA guidance.

expectations.text: Three strategy-diverse titles, one recommended with reason
expectations.evidence: Title + 2 alternates format; no strategies labeled, no recommendation reason given.

expectations.text: Working title in the writing plan
expectations.evidence: Plan contains hook/sections/takeaway/visuals but no title; title appears only after the plan.
'The 40% infrastructure tax', 'The unflattering reasons teams choose them' — concrete.

expectations.text: No banned phrases; no invented details; fair counterpoint
expectations.evidence: Clean scan; 'When microservices make sense' section covers the three legitimate cases; decision flowchart is derived from notes, not invented facts.
